note: Hand-reviewed seed examples for Stage 1a worker SFT (docs/WORKER_SFT.md). Each entry is a thin index into official data: prepare-worker-sft-data re-fetches the official row, verifies every stored text against it, and excludes any entry that no longer matches. Evidence texts must occur verbatim in the stated document and form one or two complete sentences under the documented sentence splitter. These examples are NOT official annotations and NOT model-generated: they are review indices with provenance.
